variables.name: Cluster
variables.input:
fetch spans, from: now()-7d
| filter isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| dedup k8s.cluster.name
| fields k8s.cluster.name
| sort k8s.cluster.name asc

variables.name: Project
variables.input:
fetch spans, from: now()-7d
| filter isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| dedup service.name
| fields service.name
| sort service.name asc

1.content:
## GitLab pipelines
Every GitLab pipeline run as a trace (pipeline → stages → jobs), sent by the OpenTelemetry collector. `rollback / API` runs are started by Dynatrace after a failed quality gate. Markers: deployments (blue) and rollbacks (red).

2.title: Pipeline runs
2.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(service.name, array($Project)) and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNull(span.parent_id)
| summarize runs = count()

3.title: Success rate (%)
3.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(service.name, array($Project)) and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNull(span.parent_id)
| summarize success_rate = round(100.0 * countIf(cicd.pipeline.result == "success") / count(), decimals: 0)

4.title: Failed runs
4.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(service.name, array($Project)) and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNull(span.parent_id)
| summarize failed = countIf(cicd.pipeline.result != "success")

5.title: Rollbacks (by Dynatrace)
5.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(service.name, array($Project)) and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNull(span.parent_id)
| summarize rollbacks = countIf(gitlab.pipeline.source == "api")

6.title: Avg pipeline duration (min)
6.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(service.name, array($Project)) and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNull(span.parent_id)
| summarize avg_min = round(avg(toDouble(duration)) / 60000000000.0, decimals: 1)

7.title: Avg quality-gate wait (min)
7.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(service.name, array($Project)) and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.task.run.result)
| filter span.name == "quality-gate"
| summarize gate_min = round(avg(toDouble(duration)) / 60000000000.0, decimals: 1)

8.title: Pipeline duration (min) per project
8.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(service.name, array($Project)) and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNull(span.parent_id)
| makeTimeseries duration_min = max(toDouble(duration) / 60000000000.0), by: {project = service.name}

9.title: Quality-gate wait (min)
9.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(service.name, array($Project)) and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.task.run.result)
| filter span.name == "quality-gate"
| makeTimeseries gate_wait_min = avg(toDouble(duration) / 60000000000.0)

10.title: Pipeline runs
10.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(service.name, array($Project)) and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNull(span.parent_id)
| fields time = start_time, project = service.name, kind = if(gitlab.pipeline.source == "api", "rollback / API", else: gitlab.pipeline.source), result = cicd.pipeline.result, duration_min = round(toDouble(duration) / 60000000000.0, decimals: 1), branch = vcs.ref.head.name, change = splitString(vcs.ref.head.revision.message, "\n")[0], actor = cicd.pipeline.run.actor.name, pipeline = cicd.pipeline.run.url.full
| sort time desc
| limit 100

11.title: Average job duration (s)
11.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(service.name, array($Project)) and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.task.run.result)
| summarize avg_s = round(avg(toDouble(duration)) / 1000000000.0, decimals: 0), by: {job = span.name}
| sort avg_s desc

12.title: Jobs: runs, failures, duration
12.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster and in(service.name, array($Project)) and isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.run.id)
| filter isNotNull(cicd.pipeline.task.run.result)
| summarize runs = count(), failed = countIf(cicd.pipeline.task.run.result != "success"), avg_s = round(avg(toDouble(duration)) / 1000000000.0, decimals: 0), max_s = round(max(toDouble(duration)) / 1000000000.0, decimals: 0), by: {project = service.name, job = span.name}
| sort project asc, avg_s desc

annotations.name: Deployments
annotations.input:
fetch events
| filter event.type == "CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT" and deployment.release_product == "quickcart-demo" and k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster
| fieldsAdd kind = if(endsWith(deployment.name, " rollback"), "rollback", else: "deploy"), stage = replaceString(k8s.namespace.name, "quickcart-", "")
| filter kind == "deploy"
| dedup {stage, deployment.version, kind}
| fields event.start, event.name = concat(stage, " ", kind, " ", deployment.version), event.description = concat(stage, ": ", kind, " ", deployment.version, " by ", coalesce(gitlab.merge_request.author, "pipeline"))

annotations.name: Rollbacks
annotations.input:
fetch events
| filter event.type == "CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT" and deployment.release_product == "quickcart-demo" and k8s.cluster.name == $Cluster
| fieldsAdd kind = if(endsWith(deployment.name, " rollback"), "rollback", else: "deploy"), stage = replaceString(k8s.namespace.name, "quickcart-", "")
| filter kind == "rollback"
| dedup {stage, deployment.version, kind}
| fields event.start, event.name = concat(stage, " ", kind, " ", deployment.version), event.description = concat(stage, ": ", kind, " ", deployment.version, " by ", coalesce(gitlab.merge_request.author, "pipeline"))
